Lithuania holds one act, the Konstitucija, with in-force history from 1992-11-02 to 2022-05-22 (12 versions); none of the five main codes and no case law are held. No constitutional amendment after 2022-05-22 was found, so the 2022 end of the record looks current for that one act, but every official site tried (e-tar.lt, e-seimas.lrs.lt, lrs.lt, lrkt.lt) returned 403, so no provision could be checked against the official text.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
